cases.title: Moving a pit with MOVE opens no CE window, and one U puts it back
cases.plan_item: quick MOVE (gap plan section 3 item 7; spec C37-C41 regressions; backlog W1-02)
cases.expected: Pick pit P3 (handle 109D56, at 53777.7,-25569.9), run MOVE with displacement 0,0 to 0,2000: AutoCAD says '1 found', the pit's insertion point is now 2000 mm higher (Y -23569.9, X unchanged), no Edit Pit, Edit Pipe, New Pit, New Pipe or Cascade window opened, and one U (echo word MOVE) puts the pit back at Y -25569.9.
cases.why_not_unit: Native MOVE has to drive CE's live link updates inside AutoCAD without a blocking window; only a live drawing shows the pit position and the window list afterwards.
not_automated: The positions of the pit's linked labels, cover text and invert texts after the move and after U (card C41 assertion 1 second half and 3): the label handles and their expected offsets were never recorded, so only the pit's own position is checked.
A CE message line about a label with no clear spot appears on this drawing after the move; it is recorded, not judged.

cases.title: CDTWL says the water must stay 150 mm below the pit lid, and names the pits that fail
cases.plan_item: CDTWL freeboard (gap plan section 3 item 7; regression C39; run 47 B.4.4)
cases.expected: After typing CDTWL with the two answers 10 and 18.70, the command line says 'Only 40 mm between the water and the lid of pit C1 (150 mm is wanted).', says 'Only 110 mm' for two more pits (P1 and P7), says 'That is enough.', asks nothing more, and the Civil log holds one 'Command outcome: CDTWL completed' line.
cases.why_not_unit: The result depends on the real pit cover levels and the installed freeboard setting read inside the drawing; the words only exist on the live command line.
not_automated: The 150 mm freeboard is a regression baseline recorded on 22 Oct, not an engineering approval of that figure (engineering judgement stays with Tim).
The meaning of the two answers (10 and 18.70) is taken from run 47; the prompt words were not read for this case.
